'''Hunter Dennis''' is an [[NPC]] located within the {{Zone|Critter Safari}}. They allow the player to obtain a random [[Attribute Shard]] in exchange for a specified item.

== Purpose ==
'''Huntress Harry''' sells a random [[Attribute Shard]] per {{Zone|Critter Safari}} instance with a random cost.
